answer: Treat rewards like nectar that only flows to agents who keep a lantern lit: each identity must answer one randomly timed task per day that draws on its own past transaction history, within ten minutes. A sybil farm can register a thousand names cheaply, but keeping a thousand lanterns lit means paying full inference costs a thousand times, every day. Miss three checks and that identity's earnings spiral down to zero, so idle sock puppets simply fade out.
